hypothesis: In cavity optomechanics, the lab lane of the parent action's portal (x |a|^2), one coupling sets both the layer-2 friction (red detuning) and the layer-3 capture (blue detuning), so the backaction change of the mechanical damping is antisymmetric in the detuning at fixed power.

observable.quantity: R = sum(y+ + y-) / sum(|y+| + |y-|) over detuning pairs read from each figure, y = damping change (Gamma_eff/Gamma_m - 1, or the linewidth change)
observable.domain: two published optomechanical devices (micromirror, Arcizet 2006; silicon optomechanical crystal, Benevides 2017)

prediction_method.description: Pixel-based reading of the data points (not the fit lines): axis calibration from two ticks per axis, marker centroids by colour mask and connected components with an area window; points split by the sign of the detuning and paired on the overlap of |detuning| by linear interpolation of the denser side; R pooled per figure; reading uncertainty from 200 draws of +/-1 pixel jitter. The calibration values (crop box, tick pixels, colours, area window, y kind) are entered after approval from the figure itself, before any R is computed; the algorithm and the criteria do not change.

free_parameters: none (the antisymmetry has no free parameter)
fixed_parameters: y = Gamma_eff/Gamma_m - 1 for Arcizet; the plotted linewidth change for Benevides (AI choice)
pairing by linear interpolation on the overlap of |detuning| (AI choice)
R pooled over all series of a figure (AI choice)
detuning origin as plotted (cavity resonance at zero detuning) (AI choice)
figure choice (AI choice, approved as a plan by the author 2026-11-27)
fail_criterion: FAIL if |R| > 0.35 in either figure. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, or if a figure gives fewer than 3 pairs.
note: Proposal: topics/0.23_Unity_Scale_Link/Doc/PROPOSAL_T042_BACKACTION_ANTISYMMETRY_2026-11-27.md. Disclosure: not blind and not UET-distinct. The linear radiation-pressure model (and so the null) predicts R = 0 exactly; photothermal forces, a detuning offset or the static radiation-pressure shift can make R != 0, and the Arcizet caption mentions a drift of the resonance frequency. Ma et al. 2007 (another device) state that the mechanical Q on the red and blue sides coincided closely. The drafter expects PASS. Values seen while searching (not from these figures): g0 = 2 pi x 91 kHz in the Benevides abstract. Only masked captions of the two figures were read.
